rules: Reproduce a published financial design with declared alternative learners and three splits; do not claim exact replication of its 100-split numerical table
No row exclusion unless required fields missing; report it
Eligibility ATE and participation LATE are distinct targets
Compare independent score algebra to installed DoubleML using identical folds and nuisance predictions
Sampling covariance uses iid working law; public extract has no PSU/stratum/weight specification
Outcome and income use archived data units, with no inflation update
